According to the rules sheet photographed for Dream Chamber, Conference Room and Meeting Room use is limited to academic purposes, such as work or discussions related to hands-on projects. Bookings may be made at the Reception counter or by email to innowing@hku.hk on a first-come-first-served basis. The Meeting Room is designated for team meetings or hands-on work activities rather than individual use; the sheet suggests learning commons or library facilities for individual work.
